selection: maximum training terminal equity, separately within each common fee and lag; ties use configuration order
sampling: first eligible aggregate trade in each UTC minute; all ticks are read for causal anchor selection; no fabricated or resized trade quantities
arbitrage: profit-maximizing arbitrage before and after each sampled request, no arbitrage between samples; zero external hedge cost
customer_limit: at most 50 bps worse than the recorded execution price, an assumed willingness to pay, not observed customer intent
costs: fees reinvested in inventory; active CLMM external rebalance pays 10 bps plus 1 USDT; oracle and transaction costs shown as assumptions/headroom, not measured deployment gas
interpretation: sampled single-venue counterfactual; 0-second anchor is an ideal contemporaneous-price control; ETH/USDT is not WETH/USDC settlement
